criteria.reason: The collect-findings contract has the judge return `files` (repo-relative paths the failure log points at, `[]` when none) for each CI failure, and step 4 records those `files` on the row as `files`.
The route command printed one routing for each of the 10 open blocking fixture rows. Contract step 3 runs `ci-fix-route.js route` before the direct and reconcile paths.
fix-findings step 3 sends sweep work (`work.kind` is `sweep`) to step 4 before any routing; only non-sweep (TRD) work runs `ci-fix-route.js route`.
The route output shows the test-only row as `direct`, and the jest case 'test file is direct' passed.
The route output shows the row naming only the CI workflow file as `direct`, and the jest case 'workflow is direct' passed.
The source-file, doc, package.json and mixed test-and-product rows each route `reconcile` with a non-empty reason. The matching jest cases passed.
Each of these rows routes `reconcile`: empty files ('no files recorded'), /etc/passwd and ../outside.js ('unsafe path: ...'). The matching jest cases passed.
A [lint] row routes `reconcile` ('lint row'), never `direct`. Contract step 2 keeps [lint] rows on the formatter, and the jest case 'lint row reconciles' passed.

The direct path handles one `direct` row at a time, in order: clean tree (`git status --porcelain`), a scoped app-debugger that may return `needs-product`, `ci-fix-route.js check-diff`, then a code-reviewer that reads only that diff; it finishes before the reconcile path runs.
After the diff-only judge, the contract runs the affected tests for changed test files and `actionlint <files>` for each changed CI config file, undoing if actionlint is not installed.
A pass commits only the changed paths by pathspec (`git add -- <paths>`, `git commit ... -- <paths>`, never `git add -A`) and resolves the row `fixed directly at <sha>`.

Each failure sends the row to reconcile: a dirty tree routes every row to reconcile before any edit; a refusing agent edits nothing; a failed diff check, judge, test or actionlint run triggers undo, which restores every changed path and deletes created files, all of the row's edits, then hands the row to reconcile.

The reconcile path, which calls `implement-trd --reconcile --chained --shipping`, runs only when reconcile rows remain and is not called with none; the direct path states no whole-branch review runs for a direct fix.
`npx jest packages/core/contracts/ship-primitives.test.js` passed. That includes the direct-path case (no implement-trd, no /code-review) and the product-code reconcile case.
